decision.observation: Car at 6 mph and clearly advanced — the big puddle is now behind/beside the nose, cream/red barrels further behind at lower-left. Car centred on the tarmac lane, dots dark, red X still lit. Lane ahead bends left then right, more blue puddles up-screen. Timer 59:50.
decision.hypothesis: The longer 1.0s hold broke through the puddle drag and got the car moving properly; momentum now exists and plain throttle should keep it rolling through the next puddles.
decision.memory: When speed plateaus at 0-1 mph in the puddle field, a full 1.0s throttle hold breaks through where repeated 0.7s taps do not. Puddle drag, not collision, is the usual cause of these stalls.
